summary: Exact candidate 811f07d correctly skips two CUDA JIT eligibility paths below sm_80, but leaves the original issue's standalone sgl_kernel_jit_qknorm path able to probe and compile on sm_75. This is a partial fix, not a full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression failed 12/12 on exact base 358c163 because the architecture gate was absent.
Candidate's regression passed 12/12 for its two covered modules and mocked sm_75/sm_80/sm_90/sm_121/ROCm boundaries.
Fused QKNorm+RoPE and residual-gate rejected sm_75 before loading, but standalone layernorm.norm can_use_fused_inplace_qknorm returned true and invoked _jit_qknorm_module once.
HIP gate stayed enabled on AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 and the JIT kernel matched a CPU-fp64 expression with max_abs=0.0 for the fp32 fixture.
Candidate evidence text contains trailing whitespace in three raw-output files; source changes themselves showed no whitespace error.

gpu_execution_evidence: Assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Candidate residual-gate HIP JIT executed and matched the independent numerical expression.
remaining_counterexamples: On simulated CUDA sm_75, python/sglang/kernels/ops/layernorm/norm.py::can_use_fused_inplace_qknorm still calls _jit_qknorm_module; this corresponds to the original issue's sgl_kernel_jit_qknorm_* failure and is reachable from diffusion apply_qk_norm.
The exact pip CUDA 13 plus host glibc rsqrt/rsqrtf clash was not runnable on the ROCm-only assigned host, so compiler-level success or latency elimination remains unverified.
No FLUX.2-klein-4B weights were available, so full denoise first-step latency was not measured.
remaining_limitations: Available GPU was AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti/sm_75 with CUDA 13.
No CUDA nvcc or reporter model weights were available.
The real GPU execution validates only the candidate's ROCm non-regression boundary, not the reported CUDA compiler failure.
